title: Day 1 Forecast Discussion
discussion:
Ordinary to moderate thunderstorms are expected

---Discussion---

Storms in South Bavaria into Austria should be moderate and fairly isolated. the main threats would be hail and wind gusts.

For the storms in North Poland, we could see some hail and also a very weak and brief tornado events.

In the GNRL stretch the thunderstorms will mostly be isolated and unsignificant.

---Risk Areas---

SLGT #1
Poland

Moderate thunderstorms are expected.
The main threats are:
- Hail
- Wind gusts
- Tornado - A low tornado potential exists

SLGT #2
Austria & Bavaria

Moderate thunderstorms are expected in mostly late evening, where isolated thunderstorms with strong wind gusts could initiate
- Hail - up to 1cm
- Stronger wind gusts - 70km/h+
